description: Extends the org-shared FS-GG preset (github>FS-GG/.github), the same single line every sibling receiver carries. The preset supplies config:recommended + the dependency dashboard + semantic commits, the FS.GG.* -> nuget.org datasource routing, and the shared caps and grouping rules.

The load-bearing part for THIS repo is `gitIgnoredAuthors` (.github#1533). FS.GG.Net adopts BOTH App-pushing workflows — .github/workflows/kit-materialize.yml and .github/workflows/lockfile-sync.yml — which push a follow-up commit onto Renovate's OWN branch as fs-gg-cross-repo-dispatch[bot]. Renovate reads a foreign-authored commit on its branch as a user edit and permanently abandons the branch, so the FIRST bump of any dependency lands and every later one freezes. It is silent: a bump that is never proposed is not an error, and no check anywhere goes red. That is measured, not feared — 19 branches parked across 5 repos, one identity, zero human edits (.github#1539). A preset only reaches a repo that extends it, and until this file existed FS.GG.Net extended nothing while carrying both pushers, so it was pre-broken rather than merely unconfigured (#33).

NO hostRules BLOCK HERE, and that is deliberate — do not add one (#33 AC4). SDD, Rendering and Governance each carry one supplying the Mend App Secret FSGG_PACKAGES_READ_TOKEN for nuget.pkg.github.com, on the stated premise that 'FS.GG.* are not on nuget.org'. That premise was false for all 32 of the 32 packages the org publishes, and the token never resolved either, because a 401 on a Renovate datasource is an empty version list rather than an error — which is how it froze the FS.GG.SDD.Cli pin four times (.github#576). FS-GG/.github removed the block from its own config for exactly that reason; those three siblings have not caught up, so copy FS.GG.Game or FS-GG/.github here, not them.

It is moot for this repo twice over. This repo's root nuget.config <clear/>s every source and declares api.nuget.org ALONE, with packageSourceMapping routing * there, so nuget.pkg.github.com is not a feed FS.GG.Net can read from at all. And BOTH of its FS.GG.* dependencies are public there: FS.GG.Kit (Directory.Packages.props) and fs.gg.coord.cli (.config/dotnet-tools.json) — verified id-by-id against api.nuget.org, not inferred. That is where the preset already routes FS.GG.*, anonymously. Both are enumerated deliberately rather than counted from memory: .github#576 is the case where the enumeration was never actually done, and the wrong premise then survived four freezes.

KNOWN GAP, tracked in .github#1552 — NOT fixed here, and deliberately not patched around locally. The preset disables Directory.Packages.props and .config/dotnet-tools.json for every repo except FS-GG/.github (matchFileNames + matchRepositories '!FS-GG/.github'). That is correct for a build-config RECEIVER, where those files are the distributed org baseline and repo-owned pins live in Directory.Packages.local.props. FS.GG.Net is NOT a build-config receiver (registry/repos.yml), has no *.local.props, and carries no inline Version= anywhere — so both of the files holding 100% of its pins are disabled, and Renovate will propose github-actions and global.json updates here but no NuGet ones. The remedy belongs in the preset, where it also fixes FS.GG.Audio, which is in the identical position. A local re-enable rule here would be a second dialect and a duplicate that must be kept in step with the preset fix — the exact defect .github#850 was filed about. Do not add one; land .github#1552 instead.
